sections.shortTitle: Sindh Advisors Appointments Powers Functions Salaries Allowances and Privileges Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I 2003
ACT I 2003
SINDH ADVISORS
(APPOINTMENTS, POWERS, FUNCTIONS, SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT,
2003
An Act to provide
for appointments, powers, functions, salaries, allowances and privileges of
Advisors to the Chief Minister of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 18th March, 2003]
No. PAS/Legis-B-3/2003, dated
12-3-2003.---TheSindh Advisors (Appointment, Powers, Functions, Salaries
Allowances and Privileges) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 26th February, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 10th March, 2003, is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.--This act may be called the Sindh Advisors (Appointments,
Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003:
(2) It shall come into force at
once and be deemed to have taken effect on and from 1st January,
2003.

It is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Definitions.--In this
Act, unless the subject or context otherwise requires, the following
expressions shall have the meanings hereby assigned to them respectively;
(a) "Advisor" means a
person appointed as an advisor to the Chief Minister under the Act;
(b) "Chief Minister"
means the Chief Minister of Sindh;
(c) "Family" means the
wife, children and parents residing with and wholly dependent upon the advisor;
(d) "Governor" means
the Governor of Sindh;
(e) "Government" means
the Government of Sindh;
(f) "prescribed" means
prescribed by rules framed under this Act

ACT I 2003
ACT I 2003
SINDH ADVISORS
(APPOINTMENTS, POWERS, FUNCTIONS, SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT,
2003
An Act to provide
for appointments, powers, functions, salaries, allowances and privileges of
Advisors to the Chief Minister of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 18th March, 2003]
No. PAS/Legis-B-3/2003, dated
12-3-2003.---TheSindh Advisors (Appointment, Powers, Functions, Salaries
Allowances and Privileges) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 26th February, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 10th March, 2003, is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
4. Appointment and term of
office.---(1) The Chief Minister may, in his discretion from time to time
advise the Governor to appoint such number of persons as he considers
necessary, to be Advisors who shall hold office during the pleasure of the
Chief Minister:
Provided that an Advisor
appointed on or after 1st January, 2003 shall be deemed to have been appointed
under this Act.
(2) An Advisor shall exercise
such powers as may be delegated and perform such functions as may be assigned
to him by the Chief Minister.
